notes.title: Thank you for your support on the release!
notes.notes:
Thank you for giving To Hell with the Ugly such a warm welcome! 
We really hope that you enjoy playing the game as much as we enjoyed making it.

If you’d like to support it and spread the word, you can help us get to 10 reviews by sharing what you think about it! 

[previewyoutube=KAN2l4Y0X7Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Want to know more about what it’s like to adapt a novel into a video game? Check out the latest issue of our newsletter, where Fiona Rosette (game and narrative designer of To Hell with the Ugly) talks about her experience!

And lastly, thank you to everyone who reviewed the game. The support and feedback are much appreciated!

They are talking about our game!
